reply.text:
Sore feet after running are a symptom, and that one is for a doctor or physio to look at, not me. I won't guess at what's causing it or whether it's safe to run through it.

What I can do is keep your training going around it. Tell me which session is coming up and what's on the plan for it, and I'll help you work out a swap or a rower-based option that fits your week, with the running held back until a clinician has cleared it.
